rationale: Theorem and lemma authoring both select exactly one named theorem and its body; there is no inference that a definition or axiom proves the prose. Tests reject a def, axiom, anonymous example, absent body, binder-default-only header, duplicate name, and an indented sibling command. A multiline theorem fixture retains the final proof line while excluding the following theorem; raw strings and comments do not create false matches. Rendering tests check the exact qualified target, proof text, one selector, and all combinations of forbidden nested proof/definition/example blocks. Lean compilation and the correspondence of the theorem statement remain separate checks, as stated.
limitations: This is a source and test-body correspondence review. It does not claim that the reviewed test suite, Lean compiler, browser, or configured command profiles were executed by this reviewer. Named context inputs were consulted for the relevant helpers, fixture declarations, or presentation rules; unrelated declarations in conservative file snapshots are not asserted to have been fully reviewed.
